lines.intro_01: Greetings, Captain. I am new here and looking for work.
lines.backstory_01: There is not much to tell yet, Captain.
lines.hire_offer_01: I could ride with you, Captain, for a fair price.
lines.hire_accept_01: Then it is settled, Captain. Lead the way.
lines.job_status_01: Do you have any orders for your alley, {?CONVERSATION_NPC.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}
lines.role_ask_01: What role do you have in mind?
lines.role_too_many_01: I already have quite a few duties. Perhaps you could relieve me of one of them, so that I can take on this new responsibility?
lines.mission_offer_01: I have a mission for you...
lines.mission_ask_01: What do you want me to do?
lines.forage_ask_01: As you wish. Will I take some troops with me?
lines.fire_reaction_01: What? Why? Did I do something wrong?[ib:closed]
lines.fire_farewell_01: Well... I don't know what to say. Goodbye, then.[ib:nervous2]
lines.fire_cancel_reply_01: Well {PLAYER.NAME}, it is certainly good to see you still retain your sense of humor.[if:convo_nervous][ib:normal2]
lines.lord_offer_busy_01: I would be honored, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}. But I can't take on any new responsibilities while leading this caravan. If you wish to relieve me of my duties, we can discuss this further.
lines.lord_offer_accept_01: Thank you, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}. I have often thought about that. If I had a fief, with revenues, and perhaps a title to go with it, I could marry well and pass my wealth down to my heirs, and of course raise troops to help defend the realm.
lines.lord_no_fief_01: My {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}, as much as I appreciate the gesture, I am not sure that you have a suitable estate to grant me.
lines.lord_where_01: Where exactly did you have in mind?[if:convo_happy]
lines.lord_fief_selected_01: {SETTLEMENT_NAME}? This is a great honor, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}. I will protect it until the last drop of my blood.[ib:hip][if:convo_happy]
lines.lord_name_house_01: My {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}, it would be an honor if you were to choose the name of my noble house.
lines.lord_thanks_01: Thank you my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}. I will always remember this grand gesture.[ib:hip][if:convo_happy]
lines.lord_rejected_01: It's only normal that you have second thoughts. I will be right by your side if you change your mind, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}.
lines.grievance_start_01: {TITLE}, there is something I wish to discuss with you.
lines.grievance_desert_01: I don't like running away from a battle like that.
lines.grievance_wage_01: I should remind you that I expect to be paid as you had promised.
lines.grievance_starve_01: I hear we're running low on food. We should watch our stocks better.
lines.grievance_raid_01: Pillaging villages is not what I signed up for.
lines.rescue_join_reply_01: All right. It's good to be back.
lines.rescue_alone_reply_01: I will go off on my own, then. I can stay busy. But I'll remember - I owe you one!
lines.rescue_party_go_01: We'll make ready to set out at once.
lines.prison_break_rejoin_01: I'm ready to rejoin you. I'm in your debt.
